title: Nuggets HC Calls Out How Nikola Jokic Is Being Treated Around the League - NewsBreak
text:
By Kenny Nosay ,
1 hours ago
Nikola Jokic (Image Credits: Imagn) Denver Nuggets big man Nikola Jokic gets hit a lot on the court on a nightly basis. Sometimes, the hit might become borderline unsportsmanlike. That’s why when Lu Dort intentionally tripped the three-time league MVP during a game, Jokic immediately lost his cool .
For the Serbian-born superstar, he has no qualms with physicality as long as there are no cheap shots involved. But whenever he gets hit in a suspicious manner, he will always retaliate. And that’s a fact. Now, Nuggets head coach lamented to reporters that his beloved big man isn’t being respected enough during games as he’d like.
“Nobody’s being guarded like him in the league. Nobody. Nobody’s going at the knees of other MVPs. Nobody’s taking the shots like he’s taking,” David Adelman said to reporters.
“But that’s our reality. We just try to continue to win games. He has to play through that physicality. I have no problem with him reacting [to missed calls],” he added.
Despite leading the Nuggets to an NBA title and winning the league’s Most Valuable Player award three times, Nikola Jokic doesn’t get much help from the referees. He’s just shooting under eight foul shots per night – well below the averages of other stars in the league.
Nikola Jokic Airs His Side After Nuggets-Thunder Fiasco Nikola Jokic (Image Credits: Imagn) There’s no question that Lu Dort made a questionable play towards Nikola Jokic. Cameras clearly caught the OKC guard/forward extending his foot when the Nuggets’ big man was sprinting for defense.
And Jokic did not like Dort’s dirty play . He doubled down on it in an interview, saying, “Unnecessary move, and a necessary reaction. There is no such thing — I think there’s not supposed to be those things on a basketball floor. So it was just an unnecessary move and a necessary reaction by me.”
Dort’s got to be careful whenever these two teams cross paths again. There’s a chance that Nikola Jokic won’t be too forgiving should another similar incident happen on the floor.
